title: Book Two · Chapter 83: One Less Afternoon
story:
By late autumn, Leo has reading on Saturday and another learning activity on Wednesday afternoon. He still comes to school with jokes. But on some Thursdays, he is quiet before lunch.

One Thursday, Ronan finds him beside the window. Leo rubs his eyes. A half-finished practice page lies on his knees.

“Are you ill?”

“No. I finished late.”

Ronan sits beside him. He wants to see the page, but Leo turns it over.

“Not now.”

“Do you have another room today?”

“Only school.”

Leo looks outside. Jun is waiting with the ball. He lifts it above his head. Then he lets it fall into his arms.

“I want Wednesday back,” Leo says.

“Can you ask?”

“I asked once. They said it was good for me.”

Ronan thinks of the cost paper in his tin. His family checks the cost of every visit. Leo's family seems to add more activities. Ronan wants more visits. But Leo wants less work.

“Tell them about last night,” Ronan says.

“I will.”

They go outside for a short game. Leo misses an easy catch. He looks crossly at his hands. Jun rolls the next ball to him. Leo picks it up and throws gently.

The next week, he tells Ronan about the talk at home. His parents agree to stop the Wednesday activity. Leo will finish the current lessons first. Saturday reading stays. They will look at the plan again after the winter break.

“So you can come on Wednesdays?” Ronan asks.

“Some Wednesdays. I still have school work.”

“And you can sleep.”

“Mostly on Thursdays,” Leo says with a serious face.

Ronan laughs. He has never wanted Leo to stop the reading room. He wants a place there himself. He still likes the idea of an afternoon together. They could play ball.

On the first free Wednesday, Leo comes to the square. Ronan and Jun are already there. Leo walks straight to the low wall and sits down.

“Rest first,” he says.

They give him a minute. Ronan balances the ball on one knee. It falls. Jun tries and loses it too. Leo watches them try twice more. Then he stands.

“Let me show you.”

He balances the ball on his knee. He lifts his knee. The ball hits his chin with a soft bump. His mouth falls open.

All three boys stop. Leo rubs his chin. Then he starts laughing. Ronan picks up the ball and hands it back. Leo can try again, more gently.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

less＝更少；finish＝完成；agree＝同意。

## 理解问题

1. Leo想改变怎样的活动安排？
2. 他的家人同意什么有限调整？

## 读句子

**Leo / rubs / his eyes.** Leo／揉／眼睛。
